has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

timepoint.description: Documented treatment-relative timepoint; do not infer end-consolidation from a remission statement.

response.description: Explicit CR/PR/SD/PD or assessment result. Missing imaging is not CR; do not assign CR from resection alone.

radiologically_evaluable.description: Explicit evaluable/measurable disease on imaging at this assessment; null if unknown. Baseline evaluability determines the primary-response denominator.
radiologically_evaluable.title: Radiologically Evaluable

cytologically_evaluable.description: Explicit cytologically evaluable disease at this assessment; null if unknown.
cytologically_evaluable.title: Cytologically Evaluable

assessment_date.description: Actual response assessment date, ISO date at supported precision.
assessment_date.title: Assessment Date

assessment_date_precision.description: Precision for assessment_date; null if absent.

assessment_method.description: MRI, CSF cytology or clinical assessment as documented.
assessment_method.title: Assessment Method

review_context.description: Local versus central review if stated; preserve disagreements as separate assessments.
review_context.title: Review Context

assessments.description: All baseline and subsequent assessments. Empty means no assessment extracted, not no disease.
assessments.title: Assessments
